column1: # Lamakan Desert: Mia is shaken by the Manticore, recognizes her anger, and asks the others to stay close.

column3: When it attacked,\nI wanted to hurt it.\nNot just stop it.{page_break}That frightened me.{end_wait}
Mia, you were quiet\nafter the fight.{page_break}I thought you fell.\nYou wouldn't answer.{end_wait}
I was angry, Garet.\nI wasn't thinking\nabout keeping us safe.{end_wait}
Isaac, give me a moment.\nI need to steady\nmy hands.{end_wait}
Take your time, Mia.\nWe're not leaving\nwithout you.{end_wait}
